Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::orderItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		Item.allInstances()->exists(i: Item|i.Barcode = barcode)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		OrderEntry.allInstances()->exists(e: OrderEntry|e.oclIsNew() and
		e.Quantity = quantity and
		e.Item.Barcode = barcode and
		e.SubAmount = quantity*e.Item.OrderPrice and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includes(e))
}
